column1: # The skip ledger of the vendored JSONTestSuite (README.md): each
# answer a reader gives that is not the file's own, read by
# ts/test/vectors.test.ts and go/vectors_test.go. A y_ file is to be
# accepted and an n_ file refused; an i_ file's answer is the reader's
# to choose, so each i_ file is listed for both readers.
# instance (the data of `vet --exact-numbers`) or import (the schema
# text of `aontu jsonschema import`). A listed line that answers as
# the corpus says fails the run.
